new_claim.scope: Exact owner target A=I_3, iid C_c^infinity cap-one marginals with uniformly bounded support; each output density is C_c and has height <=pi/4, but the family has no common modulus of continuity.
new_claim.quantitative_certificate: For arbitrarily large s, |hat p_s(s)|>=1/125; any putative common modulus would satisfy omega(pi/s)>=1/1375.
new_claim.full_target_effect: Does not prove or refute the universal height conjecture; proves continuity has no target-uniform modulus even on a very smooth exact-target subclass.

partner_result_applied.application: Cap-preserving mollification plus deterministic square-pushforward TV contraction gives |E exp(is tilde X^2)-E exp(is X^2)|<=||tilde f-f||_1<=1/20, preserving a phase coefficient >=1/5.

unresolved_implication: Prove a dimension-free interval-density height bound on the smooth cap-one product core for arbitrary symmetric A with s_3(A)>=1, especially diffuse/coupled regimes, without losing original-coordinate product structure.
next_step: Treat any continuity theorem only downstream of height. Focus future B15 work on same-height C0 compilers for genuinely coupled original-coordinate receivers or on regularity consequences of a newly paid aggregate height theorem.
